concerns.text: SC-001 states “The proportion of variance in fatigue life mediated by residual stress is measured against the total variance explained by the full model” but does not specify the exact calculation (e.g., indirect effect ÷ total effect) or the reporting format. Add a concrete formula or procedure so the metric can be reproducibly computed.

SC-002 says “The Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of the stress‑mediated model is measured against the MAPE of the baseline model” without defining the comparison method (e.g., ΔMAPE, percentage improvement) or acceptance threshold. Clarify how the difference will be quantified and reported.

FR-005 uses a “[deferred]” placeholder for the size of the held‑out test set. While placeholders are allowed, the success criteria later (SC‑005) require measuring runtime against GitHub Actions limits, which depends on the actual data volume. Provide at least a target proportion (e.g., 20 % of the dataset) or a concrete rule for determining the split so that the test can be executed deterministically.

FR-014 requires reporting Pearson’s r and R² between estimated and measured stress, but does not state the statistical significance threshold or confidence interval for these metrics. Adding a required confidence level (e.g., 95 % CI) will make the verification unambiguous.
